title: Implement the classic Producer-Consumer problem using wait()/notify(), then re-implement it using a BlockingQueue
hint: Guard a shared queue with synchronized, wait() when full or empty and notifyAll() after changes; then simply use BlockingQueue put() and take().

title: Implement a thread-safe Singleton using double-checked locking, then compare it to an enum-based Singleton
hint: Use a volatile static instance with a synchronized block and a second null check; an enum singleton is simpler and safe against reflection and serialization.

title: Use ExecutorService to run multiple tasks in parallel and collect their results via Future
hint: Create an ExecutorService, submit Callables to get Futures, then call future.get() on each and finally shutdown the executor.

title: Use CompletableFuture to chain three dependent asynchronous calls, with proper exception handling
hint: Chain supplyAsync with thenApply or thenCompose for each dependent step, and add exceptionally or handle at the end for errors.

title: Use CountDownLatch to make a main thread wait until several worker threads complete initialization
hint: Initialize a CountDownLatch with the worker count, have each worker call countDown() after initialization, and call await() in the main thread.

title: Use a Semaphore to limit concurrent access to a resource pool (e.g., a fixed number of DB connections)
hint: Create a Semaphore with N permits, call acquire() before using a resource and release() in a finally block.

title: Implement a simple thread-safe counter three ways — synchronized, AtomicInteger, and ReentrantLock — and discuss the trade-offs
hint: Implement three versions: synchronized increment, AtomicInteger.incrementAndGet(), and ReentrantLock with lock() and unlock() in finally; compare contention and flexibility.

title: Demonstrate and then fix a deadlock between two threads locking two resources in opposite order
hint: Threads taking locks in opposite order deadlock; fix it by always acquiring the locks in one consistent global order, or use tryLock with a timeout.

title: Implement a thread-safe token bucket rate limiter
hint: Track token count and last refill time; refill based on elapsed time on each request, and guard the check-and-decrement with synchronized or a lock.

title: Call three independent services in parallel using CompletableFuture with a timeout and a fallback, and combine the results
hint: Start three supplyAsync calls, add orTimeout or completeOnTimeout plus exceptionally for fallbacks, then combine them with allOf or thenCombine.

title: Implement a thread-safe bounded cache with expiry (TTL) using ConcurrentHashMap and a scheduled cleaner
hint: Store values with an expiry timestamp in a ConcurrentHashMap, check expiry on read, and run a ScheduledExecutorService task to remove expired entries and enforce size.

title: Implement a simple retry utility with exponential backoff and jitter
hint: Loop up to max attempts, sleeping for base times 2 to the attempt, plus a random jitter, and rethrow after the final failure.
